incident-bot: PAGER -> KV-cache miss rate spike + batch fragmentation observed in eu-west-1 inference pool (auto-detected). Alerting SLO owners. root_ts=2037654321

maria (ml-runtime): taking lead. seeing lots of tiny batches instead of sustained continuous batches. latency > 2s for many requests.

sam (oncall): on it. can you dump a few sample traces and the batching histogram? linking to the trace id pattern you saw.

maria (ml-runtime): grabbing logs now. key thing: these are tool/function calls that emit structured JSON arrays in the response. The runtime's prefix hashing for KV cache is churning because the structured outputs include ephemeral fields (timestamps/ids). Example request payload (redacted):
```json
{"user_prompt":"find stores nearby","tool_calls":[{"name":"geo_lookup","args":{"lat":51.5,"lon":-0.12}}],"structured_output":[{"options":[{"id":"u_12345","score":0.9}],"meta":{"request_id":"r-abc-999"}}]}
```
When the lambda that canonicalizes the function call doesn't normalize those inner ids, the cache key diverges and prefetch creates thousands of tiny keys.

kevin (eng-sre): confirming from host logs: KV cache size + key churn jumped at 2037654280 and steady until now. Also see continuous-batcher split events. snippet from node logs: 
```
[kv-cache] evict: 12492 keys/s, pending-prefetch: 780, batch-shard: 11 -> split
[batcher] small-batch-emitted: 0.14s avg, requeue: true
```

ryan (prodops): customer impact? any 5xx or observed user-facing errors?

elena (support): we have 4 customer incidents: two PSKs reporting slow completions (~+3s) and 1 timed-out request, one high-priority customer reported structured output missing elements. Opening tickets: INC-9221, INC-9222.

maria (ml-runtime): mitigation plan: 1) disable prefetching for structured-toolcall-heavy routes 2) increase min-batch-latency threshold to allow larger batches while we stabilize 3) deploy a quick normalizer to strip volatile ids from the canonical keying for toolcall outputs.

sam (oncall): agree. prioritize quick low-risk changes. I can toggle prefetch and adjust batch latency. maria, can you prepare the normalizer patch?

maria (ml-runtime): patch ready, small change in canonicalize_toolcall(). will push as hotfix branch `hotfix/kvcache-normalize` after config changes. Patch removes request_id/meta.* from key derivation.

kevin (eng-sre): putting commands to flip config:
```bash
# disable prefetch on eu-west pool
curl -XPOST "https://ops.api.redwood/v1/pools/eu-west-1/config" -d '{"kv_cache":{"prefetch":false}}'
# increase batching threshold
curl -XPOST "https://ops.api.redwood/v1/pools/eu-west-1/config" -d '{"continuous_batching":{"min_batch_delay_ms":100}}'
```
I'll run both now and watch.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-change/eu-west-1 at 2037654410 by kevin.

kevin (eng-sre): done. prefetch=false and min_batch_delay_ms=100 set. watching metrics.

(5m passes)

kevin (eng-sre): immediate drop in key churn rate. batch sizes recovering from mean 1.8 -> 6.1. latency trending down. no new spiking errors so far.

maria (ml-runtime): merging hotfix branch now. small canonicalization landed, running canary on 2 nodes. hotfix reduces variance in toolcall key generation.

deploy-bot: canary deploy hotfix/kvcache-normalize -> 2 nodes in eu-west-1 at 2037654570.

sam (oncall): monitoring traces. canary looks clean — no regression in function outputs. beginning phased rollout.

(10m passes)

kevin (eng-sre): metrics: KV cache evictions down 87%, average batch size up to 9. latency P95 back to pre-incident ~420ms. 5xx rate normalized.

elena (support): notifying impacted customers (INC-9221/22) with ETA and root-cause summary. will ask for post-incident follow-up and credit where appropriate.

maria (ml-runtime): next steps for follow-up: 1) add unit tests for canonicalizer to strip volatile meta 2) add integration test in precommit that simulates structured toolcall outputs 3) consider making prefetch opt-in per-route with heuristics.

sam (oncall): agreed. I'll file a follow-up RFC for prefetch heuristics + a runbook for similar incidents. tagging oncall rotation for the next 24h.

kevin (eng-sre): closing the pager if no new regressions in 30m.

incident-bot: PAGER -> Resolved: KV-cache/key-churn + batch fragmentation mitigated by toggling prefetch + canonicalization hotfix. root cause: un-normalized structured outputs creating high cardinality cache keys => prefetch stampede + small-batch emission. closed_at=2037654850

maria (ml-runtime): thanks team. filing RCA draft now. :+1:
